name: GASToolsets.AbilitySystemInspectorToolset
description:
Provides tools for inspecting the runtime state of an AbilitySystemComponent.
Each function takes a direct actor pointer and raises a script error if the
actor is null or has no AbilitySystemComponent.

tools.description: Returns all abilities granted to the actor's AbilitySystemComponent.
tools.name: GASToolsets.AbilitySystemInspectorToolset.GetGrantedAbilities

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

abilityName.description: The name of the ability class (e.g. "GA_Sprint").

level.description: The level at which this ability was granted.

bIsActive.description: True if the ability is currently executing (at least one active instance).

returnValue.description: A list of granted ability summaries sorted by ability name. Raises a script error if Actor is null or has no ASC.

tools.description:
Returns the current base and modified values of all gameplay attributes
on the actor's AbilitySystemComponent.
tools.name: GASToolsets.AbilitySystemInspectorToolset.GetAttributeValues

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

fullName.description: The fully-qualified name including the owning set (e.g. "UMyHealthSet.Health").

setClassName.description: The name of the AttributeSet class that owns this attribute (e.g. "UMyHealthSet").

baseValue.description: The permanent base value, unaffected by temporary modifiers.

currentValue.description: The current value after all active modifiers are applied.

returnValue.description: A list of attribute values sorted by full name. Raises a script error if Actor is null or has no ASC.

tools.description:
Returns the gameplay tags currently owned by the actor's
AbilitySystemComponent (includes loose tags, effect-granted tags, etc.).
tools.name: GASToolsets.AbilitySystemInspectorToolset.GetActiveTags

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

returnValue.description: A sorted list of gameplay tag name strings. Raises a script error if Actor is null or has no ASC.

tools.description:
Returns all gameplay effects currently active on the actor's
AbilitySystemComponent.
tools.name: GASToolsets.AbilitySystemInspectorToolset.GetActiveEffects

refPath.description: The reference stored as a soft path string.

effectName.description: The name of the GameplayEffect class (e.g. "GE_Burning").

stackCount.description: Current stack count. 1 for non-stacking effects.

totalDuration.description: Total duration in seconds. -1 means infinite.

remainingDuration.description: Remaining duration in seconds. -1 means infinite.

grantedTags.description: Tags granted to the owner by this effect.

returnValue.description: A list of active effect summaries sorted by effect name. Raises a script error if Actor is null or has no ASC.
